verdict.stance: Constructive / Post-Eurobond Redemption Nigerian Tier-1.5 Lender (B/B-)
verdict.summary: Fidelity Bank Plc delivered audited FY25 assets of ₦10.46trn (+18.6% YoY), PAT of ₦242.4bn, 16.2% Basel II CAR, and falling 2.4% NPLs (203.9% coverage). Crucially, Fidelity Bank redeemed its $400m 7.625% Senior Unsecured Eurobond in full on 28-Oct-26 from internal FX reserves, eliminating near-term external debt overhang ahead of CBN recapitalization.

positives: Clean full redemption of $400m 7.625% Eurobond on 28-Oct-26 de-risked hard-currency liquidity.
Strong FY25 asset quality improvement: NPL fell to 2.4% (vs 3.1% FY24) with 203.9% coverage.
Robust ₦242.4bn FY25 PAT and 16.2% CAR (A+(nga) Fitch / GCR).
negatives: CBN mandatory ₦500bn international-license share capital requirement drives ongoing equity raises.
High Nigerian sovereign bond / CRR exposure (constrained at B/B- sovereign ceiling).
Declining CBN T-bill yields from 2025 highs may normalize net interest margins in 2027.

background.business_overview: Fast-growing Nigerian Tier-1.5 commercial bank with UK subsidiary (FidBank UK).
background.asset_perimeter: ₦10.46trn assets across corporate, commercial, SME, and retail banking in Nigeria + UK.
background.ownership_governance: Publicly listed on Nigerian Exchange (NGX: FIDELITYBK).
